name: @qoretechnologies/reqore-testing
description: Entry-point stub so `@qoretechnologies/reqore/testing` resolves to dist/testing. NOT an `exports` map on purpose: 17 sibling projects deep-import extensionless paths such as `@qoretechnologies/reqore/dist/components/Button`, and `exports` subpath patterns perform no extension or directory-index resolution, so adding one would break every one of them. A folder stub is understood by Node's legacy resolver, by every bundler, and by TypeScript, and it restricts nothing.
